jobs.prompt: Edit only the supplied TreeHundredYear tower image. Preserve the exact 9:16 framing, layered tower silhouette, tower floors, roof forms, existing bridges, ring orbits, mountains, clouds, waterfalls, sky, light direction and camera position. Improve only manufactured surface condition. Make the foreground paved path, stair treads, railings, columns and non-broken bridge parapets well-maintained, finely dressed dark stone with precise construction joints and intact edges. Existing stair risers remain normal steps; do not flatten the terrain. Remove gratuitous chipped corners, random deep cracks, pockmarks, loose rubble and dirt from otherwise serviceable paving and railing. Keep subtle microtexture and restrained patina in joints, heavy believable materials, charcoal/slate stone and muted bronze, controlled blue and warm existing lights. Preserve natural rock strata and every existing story-critical gap or disconnected bridge; do not fill a chasm or build a new route. Avoid a ruin, salvage yard or abandoned factory appearance. No added palace roofs, gold-white decoration, rainbow illumination or new structures. No text, logo or watermark. This is a material correction to this project's supplied source only; no external visual templates. Deliver a new native-resolution image without upscaling.

jobs.prompt: Material-only edit of this supplied TreeHundredYear seventh-layer environment. Preserve exact 9:16 camera, platform outlines and elevations, existing machine arms, seats, instrument counts, ring/track geometry, bridge destinations, door position, natural mountains, drifting clouds, abyss and all existing intended gaps. Refine the foreground working platform and normal service stairs into complete, finely honed dark-grey stone slabs: narrow regular construction seams, intact flat slab edges, crisp safe railing profiles and precisely fitted metal joints. Remove widespread random corner breakage, ragged masonry, pitting, excess dirt and missing chunks on surfaces with no plot damage. Keep all specified fault geometry, thin plates, designated broken track points and hazards at their existing position; never make a new path, fill the abyss or alter a support contact. Natural rock may remain rugged and its floating fragments are not masonry defects to repair. Retain muted graphite, slate, aged dark bronze, restrained existing warm lamps and cool accents, original lighting direction and cinematic depth. No rainbow effects, white-gold palace redesign, added props, extra seats, characters, labels, logos or watermarks. New native-resolution file, not an enlarged copy.
